name: Rune-Inscribed Tablet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText:
As you probably know, the elements give us our power. Fire, earth, water and air--these are our tools.

Our strength comes from the spirits of our ancestors. We are the leaders of our people. Like Thrall is to the Horde, so shall we be to the villages and towns we visit. They will look to us for wisdom and protection. To be better prepared, you must train often. When you feel you've gained more power, come to me and I shall teach you what I can.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, welcome, adventurer. I'm pleased you have arrived. My days have become long and even busy what with so many students to teach, but the coming of one of your ilk brings me a great sense of accomplishment--I remember the days when I was taught by one of your shamans.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Rune-Inscribed Tablet
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
